chunks: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
"Whoever trims his nails on Saturday and Thursday, and takes from his moustache, will be protected from tooth pain and eye pain."

key_terms.عُوفِيَ: he was granted well-being or protection

ai.seo_question: What did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله say about trimming nails on Saturday and Thursday?
ai.summary: This hadith attributes a health-related benefit to trimming the nails on Saturday and Thursday and shortening the moustache. It presents personal cleanliness and grooming as part of the Prophetic tradition and links them with well-being.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.312 - The Messenger of Allah (sw) said:
"Whoever trims their nails on Saturday and Thursday and trims their mustache will be protected from toothache and eye pain."
